data.action: 遮阳伞下抱高高刨冰，浪花打湿沙滩巾后护住樱花糖浆大笑
data.description: 【海滨祭典沙滩·盛夏】蜜璃穿着粉绿花纹泳装，双手举着堆得极高的彩色刨冰，坐在遮阳伞下笑得停不下来；浪花打湿脚边的条纹沙滩巾，她赶紧把最后一勺樱花糖浆护在怀里。
data.lighting: saturated summer sun and sparkling surf
data.mood: 食欲与恋爱感一起满格的假日
data.promptProse: Mitsuri Kanroji sits beneath the festival beach parasol holding a towering colorful shaved ice with both hands, laughing as a wave wets the striped towel beside her feet. She carefully shields the last spoonful of cherry syrup. Her pink-green floral swimsuit and light wrap skirt stay clear in the horizontal medium view. Brilliant sun catches the ice crystals and incoming surf, while parasol shade keeps her face softly lit beneath bouncing braids.
data.title: 甘露寺蜜璃 · 海滨刨冰大作战
